summary: Kirmes Event Detail Page - Desktop Expanded Row 3-Column Card Layout tested successfully. All features working as expected: 3-column grid layout (KONTAKTDATEN | ZÄHLERDATEN | EMU-ZÄHLER), yellow background for rows without EMU meter, German payment status translations, all action icons visible.

Col 1 = KONTAKTDATEN (Firma, Name, Adresse, Tel clickable, E-Mail, RE-Mail, USt), Col 2 = ZÄHLERDATEN (3 card boxes for Einbau/Ausbau/Verbrauch in fuchsia + green invoice card with PDF/E-Mail buttons), Col 3 = EMU-ZÄHLER (Neu/Trennen links, meter name with Online/Offline status, 4 value boxes for Leistung kW/Spannung V/Strom A/Frequenz Hz, timestamp, Zählerdaten & Export button, QR link). Rows without EMU meter have bg-amber-50 yellow background.
